name: WEIBUILD PMC-6000iC Plastering Robot
summary: Wheeled plastering robot that pumps cement plaster onto interior walls up to 5.4 m and presses and levels it with a trowel head in one pass, guided by a 3D camera and self-levelling system. Made by WEIBUILD (Weijian) in Shanghai for public-building wall heights.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. WEIBUILD says its plastering and spraying robot series passed EU CE certification in August 2026 and that it is expanding into Europe; enquiries go to the maker in Shanghai (overseas phone and WhatsApp on the site).

specs.label: Length × width × height
specs.conditions: spec table lists Length 900mm, Width 1100mm, Height 1800mm

specs.label: Plastering rate
specs.conditions: maker figure for the series; 3 minutes per plastering cycle
specs.quote: High Operational Efficiency, 3-Minute Per Plastering, 50㎡/hour, Daily output of 300-350㎡.

specs.label: Plastering rate on site
specs.conditions: 5.5 m high interior walls, Hetao Hong Kong Park project
specs.quote: the normalized plastering operation is 40.77m ² per hour

specs.label: Operator training
specs.quote: operators can master the system after 3–7 days of training

notes: AGV chassis with four waterproof, mortar-resistant omnidirectional steering wheels; maker says it is unaffected by mortar on the floor, standing water or uneven ground. Motors are IP66 (whole robot not rated).
Pumps, applies, presses and closes the plaster in one step with a double-scraper trowel head; 3D camera visual servoing and auto-levelling (verticality ±0.015°, joint accuracy ±1 mm).
Autonomous travel between positions with obstacle recognition; workers finish corners and irregular areas.
The product text calls the high-wall model PMC-6000iE, the spec table PMC-6000iC.

images.alt: WEIBUILD PMC-6000iC Plastering Robot, picture from we-i-build.com

evidence.task: Plastered 5.5 m high interior walls of a lab and apartment complex (construction area 30,000 m²) at 40.77 m²/h
evidence.where: Hong Kong Park, Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone
evidence.note: Maker case report names its 'high wall plastering robot'. Cement plaster, not gypsum.

openQuestions: Can it apply gypsum plaster, the usual German interior machine plaster? The maker lists cement plaster only.
Weight, power supply and runtime are not stated.
